snippet.title: MSX2 SECTOR 88 ENGLISH TRAILER VIDEO (final version) by Kai Magazine
snippet.description:
SECTOR 88 FOR MSX2 IS FINALLY RELEASED
it can be ordered by writting at: kennethalbero@hotmail.com
This is a promotional video showing the game features.
The game has 11 missions, 3 endings and 10 visual stages.
This game is a rpg space shooter based on an economy system and a permanent upgrade system.
It allows freedom to play as you whish and to choose your own destiny.
